svg.text: 6 real failures and how they were fixed
Symptom, root cause and fix for what broke while building the pipeline.
Anonymous pull limit per IP, shared across CI
Pull the base image from a mirror: mirror.gcr.io
In real CI, use a mirror or credentials
The proxy re-signs traffic with a CA the

Never disable TLS: trust the right CA

Official Trivy image pinned by sha256 digest
A digest is immutable; a tag can move
--set parses numbers and the chart did not
| quote in the template. Caught by the k3s E2E
helm lint is not enough: deploy for real
IMAGE=${IMAGE,,} at the start of the job

no workflow ran for tag v0.1.0
The tagged commit, and later a PR title, carried
Drop it: GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger
Every incident is documented in the README.
